cases.title: run('update') always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update — for an unmanaged-but-present install and for a managed one after migration

titles.title: run(action) spawns bash <ctlScript> <action> for each lifecycle action and derives state from reachability on exit 0
run('update') always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update — for an unmanaged-but-present install and for a managed one after migration
run(action) maps EACH ctl exit code 1/2/3/4 to its documented reason and never throws
run(action) with a missing ctl script returns errored/not-installed WITHOUT spawning
install() spawns bash <bundledInstaller> -y; exit 0 → reachability; codes 1/2 → mapped reason
install() with a missing bundled installer returns errored/reinstall WITHOUT spawning
isInstalled() is true iff the compiled daemon entry exists, false for a clone-without-build, never throws
source-scan: vscode-plugin/src/daemon/ imports only node builtins + the shared ipc-client + the s1 surfaces (k5)
a plain start runs daemon-ctl.sh start with --skip-sync, --skip-install and --skip-build, and a run without options builds the same command line as before
